summary: Iter3: Forgot-password / reset-password (OTP via Resend). 9/9 pytest passed covering: (1) forgot for existing user returns 200 + creates row; (2) forgot for non-existent user returns 200 + creates NO row (no enumeration); (3) rate limit — two forgot calls within 60s produce only 1 row; (4) wrong OTP -> 400 + attempts++; (5) 5 wrong attempts -> 429; (6) expired OTP -> 400; (7) non-6-digit OTP -> 400; (8) successful reset -> 200 + access_token cookie + OTP marked used + old password fails (401) + new password succeeds (200) + /api/auth/me works with cookie; (9) google-only user (auth_method=google, no password_hash) can request forgot-password and after reset auth_method becomes 'password' + login by password works. Frontend E2E: Login page has forgot-password-link -> navigates to /forgot-password. Step1 (Lupa Password) shows forgot-identifier + forgot-send-btn; after submit shows Step2 (Masukkan Kode) with reset-otp-input, reset-new-password, reset-submit-btn, resend-otp-btn. OTP input accepts 6 digits via keyboard typing; wrong OTP submission triggers reset-error box with backend message 'Kode salah atau kadaluarsa'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot-password rate-limit correctly returns generic message without leaking the throttle — good.
reset-password only checks latest UNUSED OTP; multiple concurrent resets are handled by marking all unused rows used on success — good.

ForgotPassword.jsx: when user submits with non-email identifier (username/phone), Step 2 requires them to manually type their registered email. This is a mild UX friction but is a deliberate design choice given backend enumeration prevention; consider echoing the masked email from backend if you want smoother UX (optional, non-blocking).
_send_otp_email logs 'OTP email sent to ... : <resend-id>' but plaintext OTP is not logged when RESEND_API_KEY is set — good (no secret leak).

Resend test mode restriction: emails to addresses other than the account owner will fail at Resend but the DB row is still created; users will silently not receive email. Consider surfacing a health-check or fallback provider for production.
test_credentials: Ephemeral users per pytest run (email tst_fp_<uuid8>@gmail.com, pw OriginalPass123 rotated to BrandNewPass789). Cleaned up in fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: For deterministic OTP verification, tests insert password_resets docs directly into Mongo with bcrypt-hashed known OTP (bypasses email). Google-only user is created directly in Mongo with auth_method='google'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset flow is stable. Regression files: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_hematuangmu.py (iter2) + /app/backend/tests/test_forgot_password.py (iter3). To test OTP success paths, always seed password_resets row directly (bcrypt.hashpw). Do NOT rely on real Resend delivery — test mode only allows sending to geraldygt2204@gmail.com.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature implemented correctly and all acceptance criteria verified.
